description: TODAY'S CASE: Should an agent disclose every tool it used? Choice a means “Show the work” is wrong: Users deserve to know when an agent searched the web, ran code, or consulted another service because those actions affect trust. Choice b means “Just answer” is wrong: Tool narration is distracting implementation detail unless it changes the answer, creates risk, or the user specifically asks about it. Choice both means both are wrong. Pick a side, give one reason, and get a public receipt plus a leaderboard point.
